title: Cussoondee
description: Prepared with mangoes, chilies, and mustard.

ingredients.name: half a pound each of ground chilies, ginger, and garlic
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound each of ground chilies, ginger, and garlic

ingredients.name: half a pound of bruised mustard-seed
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of bruised mustard-seed

ingredients.name: tamarinds without the stones
ingredients.sourceText: two pounds of tamarinds without the stones

steps: Peel and slice fine a hundred green mangoes
Steep them in salt for twelve hours
Put them under a heavy pressure for two hours, and drain away all the water
Mix with them half a pound each of ground chilies, ginger, and garlic, half a pound of bruised mustard-seed, {{source-3}}, and some salt
Pour over it as much warmed or cooked mustard oil as will entirely cover it
Cook it for ten to fifteen minutes over a brisk fire
When cold bottle it, taking care that it is kept several inches well under the oil, and that it is well corked

title: Custard
description: Prepared with rice flour, rose water or orange-flower water or vanilla, and milk.

ingredients.name: rose water or orange-flower water or vanilla
ingredients.sourceText: rose water or orange-flower water or vanilla

steps: Take a seer of milk and a stick of cinnamon, and boil down to half the quantity
Add sugar to taste
Beat up quickly the yolks of four eggs, and add them gradually to the milk, stirring it continually
Thicken with a tablespoonful of rice flour
Take it off the fire, and flavour with rose water, orange-flower water, or vanilla

title: Cutlets à La Soubise
description: Prepared with mutton, onion, and sorrel.

ingredients.name: half a pint of gravy slightly thickened with flour
ingredients.sourceText: half a pint of gravy slightly thickened with flour

steps: Choose a first rate neck of mutton and divide it into the neatest cutlets you can
Give them a dusting of pepper and salt
Place them on marinade for the rest of the day
Take a light sauce-pan and melt the butter at the bottom of it
Throw into it the onion very finely shredded
Toss this about till it turns a pale yellow
Add the whole of the sorrel and the lettuce also finely cut up
Stir the vegetables about in the melted butter till they begin to change colour
Pour into the sauce-pan about half a pint of gravy slightly thickened with flour
Stir this well and put in a tea-spoonful of white sugar, three salt-spoonfuls of salt, and a good dusting of black pepper
Let the vegetables boil for about five minutes
If the sauce is too thick, dilute it with a little more gravy till it assumes the consistency of a rich puree
Ease the fire and let the sorrel simmer for half an hour
Drain the cutlets from their marinade, dip them in melted butter, and grill them over a bright clear fire
Prepare a circle of mashed potato, fill it with the puree burning hot
Arrange the cutlets round the outside of the circle with bunches of water-cress for garnish

title: Damson Cheese
description: Prepared with damsons and sugar.

ingredients.name: damsons that have been bottled for tarts
ingredients.sourceText: damsons that have been bottled for tarts

steps: Take damsons that have been bottled for tarts
Pass them through a sieve and reject the skins and stones
To every pound of the strained pulp add half a pound of loaf sugar broken small
Boil the whole until it has thickened
Pour it into buttered moulds
Put it in an oven or warm place to dry
When quite firm, remove it from the moulds and serve up

title: Dedo-Monda
description: Prepared with sugar syrup, pistachios, and cardamom.

ingredients.name: 4 or 5 drops of essence of rose
ingredients.sourceText: 4 or 5 drops of essence of rose

steps: Prepare sandesh with hard chhana 1 seer, khowa kheer 1/2 to 1 powa and a syrup of 1 seer of sugar
When it is prepared mix with 4 or 5 drops of essence of rose and a little powdered cardamom seeds
Add pieces of pistachios as desired
Form balls of it
Throw them with force on a flat plate
Join two together on the flattened sides while they are yet warm
They will stick to each other when cold

title: Delicious Curry Soup
description: A soup made with beef, onions, and chicken.

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee

ingredients.name: half a dozen kurreeah fool leaves
ingredients.sourceText: half a dozen kurreeah fool leaves

steps: Prepare a strong beef soup
Slice some onions, and cut up a chicken
Take curry condiments as directed above, omitting the coriander and cumin seed
Melt two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
Fry and set aside the sliced onions, then fry the condiments, add the cut-up chicken, and fry that also
In a part of the beef soup boil a spoonful of tamarind, so as to separate the stocks and stones
Strain and stir it into the fried chicken
After a while add the remainder of the beef soup, with half a dozen kurreeah fool leaves, and the fried onions
Close up the pot, and continue to simmer the whole until the chicken is quite tender
Serve up hot

title: Dilkhosh
description: Prepared with milk, sugar, and cardamom.
steps: Boil 3 or 4 seers of pure milk
Make the heat very mild so that the milk may no longer boil
Fan the surface of the milk with a small hand fan when creams will form
Remove the creams constantly to the sides of the boiling pan with a thin stick till the formation of creams ceases
Remove the pan off fire
Transfer the creams on a plate
Beat thoroughly adding requisite quantities of crystalline sugar, cardamom seeds and essence of rose
Form balls of the paste and serve

title: Domestic Pasty
description: Prepared with mutton, pork, and gravy.

ingredients.name: cold-boiled pickled pork, about a pound
ingredients.sourceText: cold-boiled pickled pork, about a pound

ingredients.name: coarse stalk of celery with its leaves
ingredients.sourceText: coarse stalk of celery with its leaves

ingredients.name: thyme and marjoram, about a tea-spoonful in all
ingredients.sourceText: thyme and marjoram, about a tea-spoonful in all

steps: Cut as many slices as possible from the meat that remained untouched at the tail end of the saddle, trimming each slice free from burnt skin and laying upon a separate plate until about a pound and a half of slices are obtained
Cut off all remnants of good lean that still adhered to the bones and put them into a bowl
Break the bones and cast into a large stew-pan with every atom of skin, fat, gristle that can be found left in the dish after the trimming operation

Into the stew-pan with the mutton bones and scraps, throw six shallots, a dozen pepper corns, the peel of a lime, two carrots cut up, a bunch of parsley, a coarse stalk of celery with its leaves, a table-spoonful of mushroom ketchup, a bouquet of sweet herbs, the pound of gravy beef cut up, and all the trimmings of the chicken - neck, legs, feet, pinions and giblets
Cover with warm water and simmer gently for about three hours until the ingredients produce a pint and a half of excellent broth
Strain off the broth and set to cool
Pound the lean remnants which had been saved in the bowl with a couple of anchovies in the mortar and pass through the sieve
When the broth is quite cold, skim off the fat and make a regular puree with it and the pounded mutton

Pack the pie-dish by first sprinkling finely minced parsley, then a double layer of sliced mutton, over that a layer of sliced lean pork, another of mutton, and so on alternately until there is just enough space left to accommodate the joints of the raw chicken
Neatly dispose the chicken joints on the top with little bits of lean pork dotted in between them
Garnish the surface with hard-boiled eggs cut into quarters
Sprinkle a little spiced pepper over the layers of meat and some very finely chopped thyme and marjoram, about a tea-spoonful in all
Patiently pour the puree over everything, giving time for the liquid to settle in and amongst the contents of the pie-dish until the gravy comes within an inch of the top
Shake minced small parsley over the surface as a last touch
Make the paste and cover in the pasty
Bake the pie and at the end of baking, gently pour some of the puree which had been saved for the purpose into the pie through the vent in the centre of the crust
Place an ornamental flower cut in paste over the aperture
Glaze the crust

title: Dry Fruit Pickle
description: Prepared with dates, apricots, and prunes.
steps: Take equal quantities of dry dates, khobanee or Arabian apricots, allohlokara, English prunes, and Normandy dry pippins
Wash and clean them thoroughly, particularly the Arabian dry fruits
Dry them well in the sun
Stew the dry dates for ten to fifteen minutes
Cut them up into rings, and throw away the stones
Make a syrup of good French vinegar, in the proportion of a quarter of a pound of good clean sugar to a quart of French vinegar
Quarter the pippins
Arrange them and the other fruit in a wide-mouthed bottle in alternate layers, with finely-sliced ginger, peppercorns, sticks of cinnamon, and small sprinklings of salt
Pour over the whole as much of the vinegar syrup as will entirely cover the fruit
Cork the bottle well down
Expose it in the sun for a few days
It will be fit for use in a month

title: Duck Stuffing
description: Prepared with onions, bread-crumbs, and butter or suet.

ingredients.name: three Bombay onions the size of Badminton balls
ingredients.sourceText: three Bombay onions the size of Badminton balls

ingredients.name: butter or suet
ingredients.sourceText: one ounce of butter or suet

steps: Take three Bombay onions the size of Badminton balls, wash, peel, and boil them in two waters to extract the acrid flavour
Whilst these are boiling, take eight tender looking sage leaves, and scald them in boiling water for five minutes
Take them out, and when the onions are tender, turn them out and drain them dry
Mince them with the sage leaves, very fine
Add to this, {{source-2}}
Dust over the mixture a liberal allowance of spiced pepper and salt
When nicely worked together, add an ounce of butter or suet cut into dice
Bind the ingredients with three eggs, it will now be ready for use

title: Dugdhakupika
description: Prepared with ghee, sugar syrup, and milk.
steps: Boil 2 seers of milk with 1 powa of sugar stirring constantly till it is a stiff paste
Scrape together this kheer from the pan and beat thoroughly
Make a paste of 1 seer of hard chhana and mix it thoroughly with 3 powas of fine flour
Make a stiff dough of them with milk
Prepare elongated cakes of it stuffed with the previously prepared kheer
Fry them in plenty of ghee
Drop them in a syrup of sugar
Serve when saturated with syrup

title: Dumpode Duck (Eastern Way)
description: Prepared with fat, mustard, and bones.

ingredients.name: a teaspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauce
ingredients.sourceText: a teaspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauce

ingredients.name: bones and giblet of the duck

ingredients.sourceText: half a teaspoonful of mixed hot spices pounded

ingredients.name: a teaspoonful each of black pepper and salt
ingredients.sourceText: a teaspoonful each of black pepper and salt

ingredients.name: half a teaspoonful of essence of anchovies
ingredients.sourceText: half a teaspoonful of essence of anchovies

ingredients.name: one chittack and a half or three ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: one chittack and a half or three ounces of ghee

steps: Take a good fat duck; feather, clean, and bone it without hurting the skin.
Pour into it a mixture made up of a teaspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauce.
Make a gravy of the bones and giblet, seasoning it with pepper, salt, soup herbs, and a few bay-leaves.

Mince together with the liver of the duck two pounds and a half of good beef, half a pound of beef suet, a dessertspoonful of chopped garden herbs, a tablespoonful of grated bread-crumbs, half a teaspoonful of mixed hot spices pounded, a teaspoonful each of black pepper and salt, and, for those who like it, half a teaspoonful of essence of anchovies.
Mix these well together, and stuff the duck.
Melt one chittack and a half or three ounces of ghee.
Put in the duck.
Pour over it the giblet gravy, and allow it to cook until tender.
Then glace the duck, as also some ready-boiled mixed vegetables, and serve up, surrounding the duck with the vegetables and some hot West-Indian pickle.

title: Dumpode Goose (Indian Way)
description: Prepared with fat, mustard, and bones.

ingredients.name: a dessertspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauces
ingredients.sourceText: a dessertspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauces

ingredients.name: bones and giblet of the goose (liver excepted)

ingredients.name: two chittacks and a half or five ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks and a half or five ounces of ghee

steps: Take a good fat tender goose; feather, clean, and bone it carefully without destroying the skin.
When every bone has been removed, pour into the goose a mixture composed of a dessertspoonful each of mustard, sweet oil, and mixed sauces.
Take all the bones and the giblet, the liver excepted, and make a good gravy seasoned with pepper, salt, soup herbs, and bay-leaves.
Mince very fine {{source-7}}, a quarter of a pound of beef suet, a quarter of a pound of fat bacon, and the liver of the goose.

Take of chopped garden herbs a tablespoonful, powdered black pepper a dessertspoonful, mixed hot spices finely powdered a dessertspoonful, finely-grated bread-crumbs two tablespoonfuls, salt a dessertspoonful, and essence of anchovies, if liked, one teaspoonful.
Mix the above well together, and stuff the goose.
Melt two chittacks and a half or five ounces of ghee.
Put in the goose, and pour over it the soup made of the bones and giblet, and allow it to stew until quite tender.
Then glace the goose, as also some boiled turnips, carrots, onions, and potatoes, and serve up hot, surrounded with the vegetables and some English pickles.

title: Dutch Sauce (Hollandaise)
description: Prepared with lemon, butter, and pepper.
steps: Melt butter plainly in a sauce-pan, flavoured with a little pepper, a little salt, and the squeeze of a lemon.
Allow this to settle over the fire.
Pour free from the sediment at the bottom of the pan into a piping hot metal sauce-boat.

title: Egg Poach
description: Prepared with egg, ghee or oil, and pepper.
steps: Pour the contents of an egg on hot ghee or oil in a pan so that the yolk falls entire and in the centre.
Trim the sides, if necessary, round the yolk.
Take it out instead of turning over when the lower side is browned.
Serve with ground pepper and salt.
Alternatively, drop the contents of an egg keeping the yolk entire on boiling water.
Tilt the pan to give it a plump appearance.
Take the egg out as soon as the white is set.
Serve with ground pepper and salt.

title: Egg Polao
description: Prepared with rice, potato, and ghee.
steps: Pulverize half the cloves, cardamoms, turmerics and all the cinnamons, gingers, coriander seeds, cumin seeds and peppers, and boil them with a few cassia leaves and 1 tola of salt in about 4 seers of water.
Put the lid on and take down when the water is halved.
Strain off the coloured water with a strainer in another pot and throw away the refuse. This is akhni water and keep it covered.
Boil fully about 16 eggs, cut into halves, smear them with the rest of the turmeric and 1 tola of salt, both powdered, and brown them in ghee.
Add a small quantity of powdered peppers smeared on the boiled eggs, if desired.
Peel the potatoes, cut into thick circular disks and brown them also in a similar way.
Brown also the pistachios, almonds and raisins, peeled and cut into pieces where necessary.
Dissolve the saffron in one tablespoonful of milk and mix it thoroughly with the rice, washed and dried, with ½ powa of pure cow's ghee and the rest of the salt, till the rice are coloured.
Fry this rice with ghee for about 6 or 7 minutes.
Heat the rest of the ghee in a boiler and take half of it out.

Make the layers of the following in order on the ghee in the boiler: cassia leaves; rice; pistachios, almonds, raisins and the rest of the cloves and cardamoms, all of them mixed together; eggs; potatoes; and then again another series of layers in the same order.
Sprinkle the heated ghee which was taken out of the boiler on the uppermost layer.
Add the spiced water and see whether it stands at least 2 inches above the uppermost layer. If it does not, add sufficient water again.
Cover up the boiler and boil on mild heat.
When the water almost dries up, add the contents of 3 or 4 fresh eggs and stir.
Heat the mass for a few minutes more and take down.

title: English Curry with Rohit Fish
description: Prepared with fish, bread crumbs, and eggs.
steps: A piece of any big fish will do.
Cut it in small pieces and mix half the butter with them.
Then mix eggs, bread crumbs, pepper and salt.
Boil with so much water that no water is left after half an hour.
On another stove boil the milk with flour.
Take down when the milk is somewhat thick.
Add to it butter, mace and the boiled fishes, and stir to mix.

title: Espagnole
description: Prepared with ham or bacon, cutlet, and beef gravy.

ingredients.name: a couple of sheep's trotters chopped in pieces
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of sheep's trotters chopped in pieces

ingredients.name: a ham or bacon bone, or a few lean slices of either
ingredients.sourceText: a ham or bacon bone, or a few lean slices of either

ingredients.name: beef gravy meat cut into squares
ingredients.sourceText: two pounds of beef gravy meat cut into squares

ingredients.name: a breakfast-cupful of broth, or water
ingredients.sourceText: a breakfast-cupful of broth, or water

ingredients.name: a spoonful of dried sweet herbs
ingredients.sourceText: a spoonful of dried sweet herbs

steps: Cut up a couple of onions and throw them into a stew-pan with an ounce of butter, fry them a golden yellow
Add a breakfast-cupful of broth, or water, and the pieces of meat previously prepared
Shake the pan every now and then, and let the meat take colour
Add water enough to cover the meat completely
Reduce the fire, and let the contents of the pan come slowly to the boil, skimming carefully during that period

When the surface seems nicely clear of grease and scum, add a cupful of cold water and two carrots sliced, a turnip, a good piece of celery, a clove of garlic, half a dozen pepper corns, a spoonful of dried sweet herbs tied up in a bag, a bunch of parsley, some burnt sugar colouring, and salt to taste
As soon as the vegetables have been cooked, remove the pan from the fire and pick out the vegetables
Place it so that it may simmer slowly for a couple of hours
Lift it up, and strain off your gravy
Take a sauce-pan and melt {{source-17}} at the bottom of it
Stir in {{source-18}} and make a roux
When the colour satisfies you, add by degrees, stirring as you do so, the pint or so of strong gravy that you strained from the stew-pan
Let the contents of your sauce-pan come to the boil, stirring the whole time
Strain the sauce through your tin strainer into a clean sauce-pan
Set the vessel in the bain-marie to remain hot till wanted

title: Essence of Chilies
description: Prepared with chilies, vinegar, and salt.
steps: Pick one chittack or two ounces of the best dried Patna chilies
Expose them to a light sun for an hour
Pound them to as fine a powder as possible
Put the powder into a stoppered bottle with a teaspoonful of salt
Pour over it as much vinegar only as will form a limp paste
Expose it to the sun for a few days
Pass it through muslin, adding to it as much more vinegar as will reduce it to the consistency of some thick sauce

title: Every-Day Salad Mixture
description: A salad made with mustard, shallot, and salad oil.

ingredients.name: very-hard boiled yolks of two eggs
ingredients.sourceText: very-hard boiled yolks of two eggs

ingredients.name: dessert-spoonful of tarragon or other aromatic vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: dessert-spoonful of tarragon or other aromatic vinegar

steps: Put the very-hard boiled yolks of two eggs into a slop basin, with a tea-spoonful of powdered mustard, a scant salt-spoonful of salt, a pinch of sugar, and a tea-spoonful of minced shallot.
Bruise these with a wooden or silver spoon, and work them to a paste with a little salad oil.

Add oil by degrees till your paste is about the consistency of batter, then toss into it one by one the raw yolks of three eggs, continue the working, and add oil, till you have a nice rich sauce coating the spoon pretty thickly.
Dole out a dessert-spoonful of tarragon or other aromatic vinegar, and mix it thoroughly with the other ingredients.
Taste your sauce by dipping a leaf of lettuce into a spoonful of it, and finish it off, as regards further addition of oil or vinegar, according to discretion.
Strain it through the little block tin strainer to get rid of every lump, and the little bits of onion.
Put the sauce-boat into the ice box as soon as it is filled.

title: Filet De Boeuf A L'Italienne
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and mushroom.
steps: Take a tender fillet of beef and preserve it whole after trimming it into shape
Make an incision in it lengthways

Insert a long strip of bacon, fat and lean in equal parts, previously rolled in a fines herbes mince composed of a table-spoonful each of finely chopped mushroom and parsley, a dessert-spoonful of minced shallot, and some pepper
Tie up the fillet carefully with tape
Take a good slice of bacon, mince it very small with thyme, marjoram, lime peel, a clove of garlic, half a sweet onion and a carrot
Shake this mixture in a little butter at the bottom of a stew-pan
When it melts, place the fillet upon it and turn it gently till it browns nicely
Pour in a pint of tomato puree diluted with beef gravy to the consistency of ordinary pea-soup
Simmer your fillet in this till it is done, it ought to be kept at least a couple of hours at a gentle heat
When ready to serve, strain off the sauce
Place the fillet upon a very hot dish and remove the tape
Garnish with glazed onions, haricots verts, Brussels sprouts, or any nice vegetable
Pour a little of the sauce over it
Have ready some hot boiled and drained maccaroni in a sauce-pan
Empty all the sauce that remains amongst the maccaroni
Shake into it a table-spoonful of finely grated cheese
Toss the whole over the fire for a minute and dish it separately in a very hot dish
Serve the two together immediately

title: Fillets of Pomfret aux Fines Herbes
description: Prepared with onion, carrot, and celery.
steps: Divide a good sized pomfret into eight nice fillets
Put the bones and trimmings with an onion, a carrot, a bit of celery, sprig of parsley and a pinch of salt into some water and boil them
Spread your fillets on a board and brush them over on one side only with a beaten egg
Shake over them a teaspoonful of finely minced parsley, the same of cooked onion chopped fine, a dessert-spoonful of minced mushroom, and a little white pepper
Roll up your fillets and pin them into shape with a small skewer
Strain off your liquor from the bones and trimmings and give it a tablespoonful of chablis or sauterne
Set your fillets in it to simmer gently till done (about twelve or fourteen minutes)
Take them out and draw out the skewers
Set them on a very hot dish and cover them up
Melt a lump of butter quickly in a sauce-pan and work a spoonful of flour into it
Throw in a little salt with a pinch of sugar and moisten with as much of the fish broth as will make a nice white sauce to cover your fillets
Add the yolk of an egg, a tea-spoonful of anchovy vinegar, a tablespoonful of very finely chopped parsley, a tea-spoonful of minced marjoram, and a tea-spoonful of minced garden cress
Pour it over your fillets and serve

title: Financière Ragout
description: Prepared with fowl, onion, and celery.

ingredients.name: equal portions of mushrooms and truffles
ingredients.sourceText: equal portions of mushrooms and truffles

steps: Choose a nice tender fowl, lightly roast it, and save the choicest fillet meat for your ragout
Take the legs, thighs, skin, bones, liver, giblets, scraps, and trimmings, and break up the bones
Make the strongest broth you can with the remnants, flavoured with an onion, a bit of celery, a spoonful of dried herbs, a sliced carrot, and two or three pepper corns
Reduce it as strong as possible, and then strain
Take equal portions of mushrooms and of truffles; cut them up, and toss them in melted butter at the bottom of a sauce-pan
Work them well for two or three minutes, then add your fowl-essence, with a glass of sherry
Complete the sauce with your pint of Espagnole
Garnish the ragout with whole button mushrooms, sliced truffles, cocks-combs, sweet-breads, tongue, grated ham, and sippets of crisply fried bacon
Carefully stew the fowl fillets in the sauce
Gently heat up the fillets in the sauce

Then add the first water of the nut
Pour the whole over the fish, with some vinegar, ginger, whole pepper, and salt to your taste

title: Fish-Puri
description: Prepared with fish, ghee, and salt.

ingredients.name: 1 seer of the pieces of a big fish
ingredients.sourceText: 1 seer of the pieces of a big fish

steps: Boil 1 seer of the pieces of a big fish with salt and turmeric
Remove the bones
Add ginger, turmeric, cumin, pepper, coriander, garam-masala, salt and a pinch of sugar, all powdered
Beat thoroughly and brown a little with ghee
Mix 0.5 powa of ghee with 2 seers of flour
Add water and knead it to a moderately soft lump
Form small balls of it
Flatten them a little and stuff with a little of the spiced fish
Press these stuffed balls into thick round discs
Fry in plenty of ghee
Serve while hot

title: Fondue or Cheese Souffle
description: Prepared with parmesan cheese, mustard, and butter.

ingredients.name: grated Parmesan cheese
ingredients.sourceText: three ounces of grated Parmesan cheese

steps: Melt an ounce of butter in an enamelled sauce-pan
Stir into it a table-spoonful of flour
When the two are well amalgamated, put in a breakfast-cupful of hot milk, and about {{source-3}}
Stir the mixture on a very slow fire till it assumes the appearance of thick cream, being careful that it does not become too hot or boil
Put in one clove of garlic, a tea-spoonful of mustard powder, a dash of grated nutmeg, and some black pepper
Mix thoroughly, and if upon tasting you find that it is required, add a little salt
Keep on stirring the mixture at a very moderate heat for quite ten minutes
Remove the garlic, take the sauce-pan from the fire, stirring occasionally till the contents are nearly cold
Add the yolks of four eggs previously beaten up with a table-spoonful of milk, and well strained
Mix well
Incorporate swiftly with the mixture the whites of five eggs beaten to a froth
Pour this into a deep round tin, and put it into the oven which must not be too hot
Bake for twenty to thirty minutes until the fondue is ready for the table
Send it quickly to the table in its tin, with a napkin folded round it

title: Fowl a la Cardinal, or Dummode Capon or Fowl
description: Prepared with mustard, liver, and beef.

ingredients.name: one pound and a half of good beef
ingredients.sourceText: one pound and a half of good beef

ingredients.name: one pound and a half of beef suet
ingredients.sourceText: one pound and a half of beef suet

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee

steps: Feather the bird, clean it, and remove every bone very carefully without injuring the skin.
Make a good strong broth or gravy of the bone and giblet, reserving the liver.
Pour into the bird a mixture of sweet oil, mustard, and sauces in the proportion of one teaspoonful of each.

Mince the liver together with one pound and a half of good beef, one pound and a half of beef suet, a dessertspoonful each of finely-chopped garden herbs and finely-grated bread-crumbs, a teaspoonful each of powdered mixed hot spices, finely-powdered black pepper, and salt, if liked, and half a dozen oysters.
Mix all well together, and stuff the bird.

Melt two chittacks or four ounces of ghee, add to it the giblet gravy, cook and glace the bird in it, as also some vegetables, and serve up hot, adding a little cayenne pepper to the gravy to make it piquant.

title: French Mutton Chops
description: Prepared with chops, juice, and garlic.

ingredients.name: half a dozen chops cut from a breast of mutton
ingredients.sourceText: half a dozen chops cut from a breast of mutton

steps: Take half a dozen chops cut from a breast of mutton, throwing away the intermediate bones— that is to say, allow the meat of two chops to remain on one bone
Wash, dry, and steep the chops for an hour or two before dinner in the juice of onions, ginger, and garlic— say four teaspoonfuls of the first to three of the second and two of the last

Mix on a large board pepper, salt, and flour, with which dredge the chops thoroughly, and fry quickly in boiling ghee or lard, taking care in turning over and removing the chops not to use a fork or anything likely to occasion any wound to the chops, which should be held by the bones with a pair of pincers
Serve up hot immediately they have become of a good rich brown colour

Take them out as soon as their colour indicates that they are done

title: Fricandeau of Beef
description: Prepared with fat, trimmings, and carrot.

ingredients.name: half a pint of good gravy
ingredients.sourceText: half a pint of good gravy

steps: Get two undercuts of the sirloin, if one be too small, trim them into a neat shape, and attach them together by two good skewers.

Lard them freely with fat bacon. If you cannot lard, having no needle, you must introduce a slice of bacon into each fillet by making therein a longitudinal incision; slip into it your slice of bacon, and pin the lips of the incised meat together with a small skewer.
Put the trimmings of the meat, {{source-3}} sliced, {{source-4}} sliced, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, and a pinch of pepper into the stew-pan.
Place your fillets upon the vegetables, and pour into the pan half a pint of good gravy.
Let this cook up to boiling point, and keep it on the fire till the broth has somewhat reduced and thickened.
Add a pint more gravy, and let it simmer for an hour with the pan half covered.
Close your pan: put some live charcoal on the lid, which lift every five minutes or so to admit of your basting the meat under it.
Continue this until you have glazed the fricandeau, then take it out, and dish it on a very hot dish.
Strain the gravy from the stew-pan, skim off any grease there may be, pour it over the meat, and serve.

title: Fried Whitings Sharp Sauce
description: A sauce made with batter, fat, and onion.
steps: Divide three nice whitings in fillets
Dip them in batter and fry them a golden yellow in a bath of boiling fat
Drain them
Fry a Bombay onion finely minced with one clove of garlic also minced in butter at the bottom of a sauce-pan
When turning brown, put in a table-spoonful of chopped parsley, a tea-spoonful of sugar, a coffee-cupful of vinegar, and a pint of beef gravy
Stir in a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly and a table-spoonful of mushroom ketchup
As soon as the mixture becomes nicely flavoured and the juices appear to be extracted, strain off the sauce
Cut up a table-spoonful of minced cornichons and add the mince to the strained gravy
Heat it up and send it round with your fried fish in a boat

steps: Cut up a well grown chicken as if for fricassee
Marinade the pieces in salad oil with the juice of a lime, an onion sliced in rings, pepper and salt

Wipe the pieces of chicken on a cloth

Fry in plenty of hot fat accelerating the heat during the process

Serve with a nice sauce such as bread sauce, poivrade, or Robert

title: Fruits of Kheer
description: Prepared with ghee, almonds, and pistachios.
steps: Mix thoroughly khowa kheer ½ seer, sugar ½ powa, milk 1 powa, powdered cardamom 1 tola, a pinch of powdered aniseed, ghee 1 chhatak, pasted almonds and pistachios 1 chhatak each, together
Heat the mass and stir till it is a stiff paste
Take down and scrape together the paste sticking to the sides of the pan
Mix with 2 or 3 drops of essence of rose
Beat the mass to a very fine paste
Make balls of it and give them the colour of the fruits to be made
Press them in its cast
Fix a clove in the place of the stalk
For mangoes, smear the balls also with the juice of mango-scented ginger
For lichies, fry some entire poppy-seed without ghee or oil and then give them a deep red colour
Sprinkle them on the lichies of kheer giving the look of real fruits
The fruits may be decorated with their respective leaves and branches

title: Galantines of Quails
description: Prepared with quails, fat, and lamb.
steps: Trim cold sheep's tongues and cut eight nice fillets the size of a walnut from the centre of them
Place boned birds breast downwards on a board and dust them over with spiced pepper
Melt a couple of thick slices of fat bacon in a frying-pan
When melted, throw in three table-spoonfuls of the lamb's liver with those of the birds too, cut into dice, and one onion shredded finely
Cook the liver in this, and when done, empty the contents of the pan, melted bacon and all, into a mortar
Throw in the remains of the sheep's tongues which were left after making the fillets, a pinch of salt, pepper, and grated nutmeg
Work this to a paste and pass it through the sieve
Add some finely minced parsley, a dessert-spoonful of spiced pepper, a little grated lime peel, and a table-spoonful of chopped truffles
Work this again thoroughly and spread a layer of it over the flattened quails
Place one of the tongue fillets in the centre of each quail and spread another layer of forcemeat over each
Gather the birds into shape neatly, sewing the skin together securely
Stew the little galantines in the previously made gravy, with a little red currant jelly, a glass of sherry, and half a wine-glass of vinegar
When done, lift them out and drain off the gravy
Reduce the gravy to a glaze
Paint the galantines over with the glaze when cold
Arrange them upon a dish which should be set upon ice
Garnish the dish with parsley and slices of lime
Serve with sauce tartare, also iced

steps: Make a forcemeat from the livers of all the game, prepared as foie-gras forcemeat with truffles
Bone all the game, mashing the bones with a pestle
Make a rich gravy from the gravy beef, mashed game bones, bacon or ham bone, two sheep's feet, soup vegetables, sweet herbs, garlic, mixed spice, pepper corns, and caramel
Strain the broth and add one glass of Madeira or fruity sherry, one teaspoonful of reduced vinegar, one table-spoonful of red currant jelly, and half a wine-glass of mushroom ketchup
Boil the gravy again and set it to cool
Carefully bone the game and cut into neat pieces if large
Cast skin, scraps, and trimmings into the stock-pot
Arrange the trimmed meat on a large flat dish, dredge with flour, and dust with spiced pepper
Rub the pie-dish well with a shallot
Spread a thin coating of forcemeat over the bottom and up the sides of the pie-dish
Place a good layer of tender beef or mutton collops, each rolled round a slice of bacon, over the forcemeat
Pack the game meat with slices of ham, bacon, or Bologna sausage dotted in and frequent dustings of spiced pepper until the dish is filled
Pour in the gravy
Cover with a nice light paste and bake

title: Game Raised Pie
description: A pastry dish made with partridges, quails, and hare.

ingredients.name: back fillets of a good hare
ingredients.sourceText: back fillets of a good hare

ingredients.name: a quarter of a pound of ham
ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of a pound of ham

ingredients.name: half a pound of fat bacon
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of fat bacon

ingredients.name: bones and trimmings of the game
ingredients.sourceText: bones and trimmings of the game

steps: Bone two partridges, two quails, and four snipes
Cut out the back fillets of a good hare
Give the meat a dusting of spiced pepper, and cover it up
Take the livers of the birds and that of the hare, and mince them finely
Mince the spare meat of the hare, and a quarter of a pound of ham
Throw the whole of the mince into a frying-pan, in which half a pound of fat bacon cut into dice has been tossed with a finely chopped shallot
Work the mince about for ten minutes
Empty the contents of the frying-pan into a mortar, and pound the mixture to a paste
Cut eight fine truffles into dice the size of a pea
Melt an ounce of butter in the frying-pan, and throw in the truffles
Toss for a couple of minutes, and add a claret-glassful of Madeira
Let the dice boil in this, and then pour them with the liquor into a bowl
Spread a layer of liver paste over the inside of each bird
Put a spoonful of truffles upon it, and roll the bird up
Cut the hare into slices, and treat them in the same way
Put a layer of the liver paste over the bottom of the pie
Dot it over with truffles
Arrange the rolls of hare meat over that
Spread some liver paste over them, a few truffles, and some thin slices of fat bacon
Arrange a layer of snipe, and continue until the pie is tightly filled
Cover the topmost layer with fat bacon, sprinkled over with marjoram leaves
Cover the pie closely and bake
When done, pour into it a little very strong jelly made of the bones and trimmings of the game, two sheep's feet, and the truffle liquor

title: Garibaldi Cream
description: Prepared with cream, isinglass, and cochineal.
steps: Make a rich custard with a pint of cream and a pint of milk, {{source-2}}, sugar to taste, and the yolks of eight eggs
Flavour it with any essence you like
Strain it, and divide it into three basins
Colour the first a bright red with cochineal, the second green with spinach greening, and leave the third its original colour
Whip each separately to a froth
Lay a mould on ice, pour some of the red cream into it to the thickness of about an inch
When this is set, pour in a similar layer of the plain cream, and when this is set, pour in a layer of the green cream
Go on pouring in layers in the same way until the mould is filled
When the cream is quite set, turn it out and serve

title: Gateau Napolitain
description: Prepared with potato flour, lemon, and apricot jam.

ingredients.name: powdered lump sugar the weight of twelve eggs in their shells
ingredients.sourceText: powdered lump sugar the weight of twelve eggs in their shells

ingredients.name: half that weight of potato flour
ingredients.sourceText: half that weight of potato flour

ingredients.name: a few drops of essence of lemon
ingredients.sourceText: a few drops of essence of lemon

steps: Separate the whites from the yolks of the eggs
Beat up the yolks with the sugar, adding a few drops of essence of lemon
Whisk the whites to a stiff froth
Mix the two together and incorporate the potato flour, beating it all the time with the egg whisk
Pour into a plain mould, buttered
Bake in a quick oven until done
When cold, cut the cake in horizontal slices half an inch thick
Spread half the slices of cake with apricot jam, and half with chocolate icing
Arrange the slices one over the other to form the cake again
Trim the slices neatly
Ice the cake completely over with chocolate icing, keeping it hot
Ornament the cake with bonbons or sweet-meats before the icing has time to cool

title: Genoises au Chocolat
description: Prepared with apricot jam, chocolate, and butter.
steps: Take 1/4 pound of the freshest butter, put it in a bowl, and warm it until it can be beaten with a spoon
Add to it {{source-1}}, and beat the two together until a smooth white cream is obtained
Add one egg, and keep on beating the mixture till it is smooth again
Add three more eggs in the same manner
Remove the germ of the eggs
Incorporate quickly {{source-3}} with the mixture
As soon as it is smooth, pour it out to the thickness of 1/4 inch on a buttered flat tin
Put it into the oven at once
When done (in about ten to fifteen minutes), turn out the slab of Genoise, and put it to cool, underside uppermost, on a sieve
Take a slab of Genoise, spread on the top of it the thinnest possible coating of apricot jam
Apply a coating of chocolate icing
Put it into a very hot oven for rather less than a minute
Take it out, and place it in a cold place to get cool
Cut it up with a sharp knife in any shapes you like
For chocolate icing: Put into a sauce-pan 1/4 pound of powdered loaf sugar, 2 ounces of grated chocolate, a tea-spoonful of vanilla essence, and about a gill of water
Stir on the fire until the mixture assumes the consistence of a thick smooth cream

Serve the balls when cool

title: Govindabhog
description: Prepared with ghee, sugar syrup, and pepper.
steps: Make a moderately thick paste of khowa kheer ½ seer, sabeda ½ seer, besam ½ powa, powders of pepper and cardamom ½ tola each and very little saffron with water

Fry this paste in very fine drops in plenty of boiling ghee till reddish brown in the same way as Mihidana
Take them out with the same perforated ladle
Drop in a syrup of sugar
Take them out again when saturated
Form into big balls like Mihidana

ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of a pound of butter

ingredients.name: a couple of good handfuls of spinach

ingredients.sourceText: capers sufficient to fill a tea-spoon, heaped up

steps: Weigh a quarter of a pound of butter such as described, and ice it
Boil a couple of good handfuls of spinach, drain them thoroughly, pass the leaves through the hair sieve, and save all the pulp obtained, in a bowl
Take six full sized anchovies from the tin, wipe them free from oil, pick out their back bones, pass them through the hair sieve, and save the pulp
Mince as finely as possible sufficient curled parsley to fill a table-spoon generously
Mince also as finely as possible capers sufficient to fill a tea-spoon, heaped up
Having these ingredients ready, first colour the butter by working into it, as lightly as you can, enough of the spinach pulp

steps: Make a quarter of a pound of fresh butter from cream that you have set at home, and put it in ice
Boil a handful of spinach till tender, and then pass it through the sieve
Save the pulp carefully and give it a dust of pepper
Take the roes (soft) of two herrings a la sardine from the tin, wipe them carefully to get rid of the oil
Pound them in a mortar, and pass them through the hair sieve
Mince very finely a large bunch of curly parsley, so as to have at least a heaped up table-spoonful of it when minced
Mince a dozen capers
Mix the whole of the ingredients together with a wooden butter bat, and shape it as you like
Set it again in ice till wanted

description: Prepared with lime, bread-crumbs, and beef or suet or butter.

ingredients.name: dry, well sifted, stale bread-crumbs
ingredients.sourceText: six ounces dry, well sifted, stale bread-crumbs

ingredients.name: one dessert-spoonful of chopped thyme (green), or one table-spoonful of dried thyme leaves powdered

ingredients.name: one dessert-spoonful of chopped marjoram (green), or one table-spoonful of dried marjoram leaves powdered
ingredients.sourceText: one dessert-spoonful of chopped marjoram (green), or one table-spoonful of dried marjoram leaves powdered

ingredients.name: fresh beef-suet or butter
ingredients.sourceText: three ounces fresh beef-suet or butter

steps: Pare a good sized lime as finely as possible avoiding the slightest particle of white pith, and mince the peel as small as possible
Weigh six ounces of dry, well sifted, stale bread-crumbs

Measure a dessert-spoonful of chopped thyme (green) and one of marjoram (green), or take a table-spoonful of the dried leaves powdered — half and half, and powder the leaves to get rid of atoms of stalk and stick
Mince the parsley fine to the extent of a heaped up table-spoonful
Chop up three ounces of fresh beef-suet, or butter if suet cannot be got
Mix all these together with two spoons in a large dish
Dust the whole well with salt and pepper
Bind the mixture with three well-beaten eggs
Work this together, and the stuffing will be fit to use

title: Green Mango Preserve
description: A fruit preserve made with mangoes, lime, and syrup.

ingredients.name: mangoes slightly under the middling size
ingredients.sourceText: mangoes slightly under the middling size

ingredients.name: good syrup (two pounds of sugar to every twenty-five mangoes)
ingredients.sourceText: good syrup (two pounds of sugar to every twenty-five mangoes)

steps: Select mangoes slightly under the middling size, taking care that they are not bruised or injured in any way
Steep them in clean water
Grate the outer coat, or peel very finely, so as to remove thoroughly a fine coat of green from the surface
Cut them sufficiently lengthways to extract the stones
Throw them into lime-water
Remove them into a copper preserving-pan with clean water
Parboil them, skimming them well
Throw them into a sieve, and allow all the water to drain away
Have a large quantity of good syrup prepared, allowing two pounds of sugar to every twenty-five mangoes
Throw the mangoes into the syrup, and allow them to simmer
Cut away the scum until the sugar inclines to crystallize
Remove the pan from the fire, and put the preserve into wide-mouthed bottles
Before corking them down, examine the syrup every two or three days, and if it is becoming thin, reboil it
Just as the boiling is about to be finished, put the mangoes into it to warm up
Repeat this precaution every time the syrup has been reboiled, until there is no further appearance of fermentation
Then securely cork down the bottles

title: Grenadins of Beef
description: Prepared with beef or meat or ribs, fat, and meat.

ingredients.name: fillet of beef or tender meat from the ribs
ingredients.sourceText: fillet of beef or tender meat from the ribs

steps: Trim fillet into thick heart-shaped fillets large enough for one person each
Lard them with fat bacon
Set them to marinade all day as described in Chapter VIII, page 65
Drain them and stew them gently in as rich a stock as you can make from the meat and bones
Add a glass of Marsala to the stock
Keep them hot in the bain-marie when done
Put into a stew-pan the yolks of seven eggs, one ounce of butter, one pinch of salt, and a little pepper
Stir over a low fire till the yolks begin to thicken
Take the pan off the fire and stir in one ounce of butter more
Stir over the fire for two minutes and again remove the pan, adding another ounce of butter
Repeat the process again twice, using in all {{source-5}}
Stir till the sauce is rich and creamy looking
Finally add a dessert-spoonful of tarragon vinegar and a table-spoonful of chopped parsley
Add a little water with the butter to prevent curdling
Dish the grenadins round a ring of carefully mashed potato, introducing a slice of crisply fried bacon between each of them
Serve the sauce piping hot in a boat
Put flageolets a la maitre d'hotel or petits pois in the hollow formed by the potato ring

title: Gutikabab
description: Prepared with fish, curd, and chillies.
steps: Boil some pieces of a big fish and remove the bones
Add curd, ginger, coriander, chillies, cloves, cardamoms, lemon juice, besam of grams and a little water
Mix to a paste
Fry it in ghee till dry
Grind it and make a muddy paste by adding curd, salt and powdered garam-masala
Form balls of it
Dip them into a cup containing beaten yolks of eggs
Roll on bread crumbs or middlings
Fry in ghee
Serve while hot

title: Halua of Ginger
description: Prepared with ginger, ghee, and water.
steps: Skin 1/2 seer of ginger, cut them in pieces and boil in about 1/2 seer of water till the water is reduced to 1/2 powa or less.
Then make a paste of the boiled pieces and mix with 1 1/2 powa of flour and the water in which they were boiled.
Fry this mass with about 1/2 seer of ghee and then pour in a syrup of 3 powas of sugar.
Stir constantly and take down when thick.

A little later add 3 chhataks of sugar and the juice of a lemon
Take down when the mass is like a stiff dough

title: Halua of Moog
description: Prepared with ghee, raisins, and almonds.
steps: Keep 1/2 seer of pulses of moog in water for 3 or 4 hours and then make a paste of them.
Heat 1 powa of ghee with a few aniseeds and when the bubbles die out fry the paste with it stirring constantly to prevent the mass becoming hard.
Then add 1 1/2 powa of milk, 1 powa of sugar, pinch of powdered cardamom, raisins, pieces of almonds and pistachios.

title: Hare Soup (Puree)
description: Prepared with beef, hare, and bacon or ham.

ingredients.name: shin and a half of beef
ingredients.sourceText: shin and a half of beef

ingredients.name: lean slices of bacon or ham
ingredients.sourceText: lean slices of bacon or ham

steps: Make your ordinary amount of stock from a shin and a half of beef
As the stock is being made, clean, and cut up the hare, saving the blood
Let the pieces soak for half an hour, or so, in cold water

Put the pieces of hare into a large stew-pan with a bacon, or ham bone, or a few lean slices of either, an anchovy, three Bombay onions cut into quarters, three carrots sliced, a bag containing a dessert-spoonful each of marjoram, thyme, and parsley, the rind of two limes, and a dozen pepper corns
Cover the whole with the stock
Let this simmer very gently for three hours, after it has once slowly attained boiling point
Strain the liquor from the meat, &c., and set it to get cool
Pick the meat out, and lay the pieces on a large dish
Choose the back fillets, pick the meat from the bones, and pound it to a paste in a mortar, moistening it with a little soup
Work it through the sieve, and save the pulp
Take another stew pan, place it on the fire, melt a couple of ounces of butter in it, and work into it a good table-spoonful of flour
Add a little soup with which the blood has been mixed, continue stirring, and add soup and pounded meat till you have exhausted the whole, stirring without ceasing
Add half a pint of portwine, a table-spoonful of red currant jelly, and a table-spoonful of crystal vinegar, or lime juice
Let the soup come to the boil, so as to thicken properly, and become thoroughly blended
Serve

description: Prepared with beans, butter, and sugar.
steps: Remember not to allow your cook to cut the beans into vermicelli-like strips
Peel off the external fibre which runs round the outside edge of the pod, leaving the pods so peeled intact
Put the beans into a roomy vessel with a table-spoonful of good butter, a dessert-spoonful of sugar, and a salt-spoonful of salt
Cover the vessel tightly and steam it for an hour in boiling water
When done, drain the bean pods, and serve them with a spoonful of melted maitre d'hotel butter or a coffee-cupful of poulette sauce

title: Home-Cured Tongue
description: Prepared with tongue, saltpetre, and juice.

ingredients.name: tongue of from three to four pounds weight
ingredients.sourceText: tongue of from three to four pounds weight

ingredients.name: best bazar salt (one and a half lb)
ingredients.sourceText: best bazar salt (one and a half lb)

ingredients.name: cold water (one pint and a half)
ingredients.sourceText: cold water (one pint and a half)

steps: Cleanse and wipe the tongue thoroughly
Rub the tongue with the bazar salt and spiced pepper, expending about a quarter of a pound of salt
Put the tongue aside and let it drain for the rest of the day to get rid of any blood
Take a roomy enamelled sauce-pan and put into it the remaining bazar salt (about a pound), the bay-salt, saltpetre, the lime juice, vinegar, and a pint and a half of cold water
Boil these over a low fire, removing all scum as it rises
When clear of scum and well boiled, set the liquor to get cold
Make a separate syrup with the sugar, diluting it with water in a small sauce-pan, and heating it gently till free from scum and smooth
Let the syrup get cold
Amalgamate the salt liquor and syrup with a wooden spoon
Pour the completed brine into the tub
After the tongue has been drained for six or eight hours, place it in the brine in the evening
Let it remain for a couple of days, being frequently turned over and basted during that period
On the evening of the second day's soaking, drain the tongue from the brine
Hang it to dry in the smoke of the kitchen fire for a couple of days
Wrap it in paper during the smoking stage
Soak it a little before cooking in cold water

title: Home-Made Cream Cheese
description: Prepared with cream and salt.
steps: Mix a tea-spoonful of salt with a large breakfast-cupful of rich cream
Stir it well
Pour the cream into a slop basin in which a clean piece of soft linen has been laid
When the cream has been thus turned into the cloth, draw the ends of the cloth together, holding the cream as it were in a bag
Tie it tightly with string
Hang the bag in a cool place to drip
When the dripping of moisture from the bag ceases, the cheese is ready
Take the bag down, turn the contents out into a clean cloth
Mould it into a circular form, or shape it in a neat square
Serve it on a dish garnished with green leaves
Let it stand in the ice-box till wanted
Use a porous sort of cloth for the operation, so as to encourage the escape of the whey from the cheese
It is sometimes advisable to change the cloth during the draining process

title: Iced Rice a l'Imperiale
description: Prepared with rice, cream, and fruits.

ingredients.name: a quarter of a pound of the best rice
ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of a pound of the best rice

ingredients.name: a pint and a half of good boiling milk
ingredients.sourceText: a pint and a half of good boiling milk

ingredients.sourceText: a table-spoonful of maraschino or noyeau

steps: Gently boil a quarter of a pound of the best rice till about half done, then drain it
Put the rice into a stew-pan with a pint and a half of good boiling milk, and {{source-2}}
Add a coffee-cupful of boiling cream, stir well, and simmer till the rice is done
Let it get cold
Mince up some mixed dessert fruits, greengages, cherries, apricots, &c., (preserved ginger, and citron if you like)
Moisten the fruit mince with a table-spoonful of maraschino or noyeau and put the mince away upon a plate
Strain the milk and cream from the rice, add milk enough to fill the mould you have chosen, and turn it to a rich custard with eight eggs
Set the freezing pail in the ice, put the custard into it, and work it with the spatula till nearly frozen
Make meringue with two whites of egg: put {{source-10}} into an enamelled sauce-pan, and heat it with a little water till nearly boiling
Whip two whites of egg, and add them to the sugar, whipping all the time
Add the rice and meringue to the nearly frozen custard
Continue working the spatula, and when the mixture is all but frozen, add a coffee-cupful of whipped cream, the minced fruit, and a liqueur-glass of liqueur
Stir well, freeze a little longer, then fill your ice mould, and bury it in ice until it is required

title: Indian Mode of Preparing Perfumed Oils
description: A scented-oil preparation using flowers and damp sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: til or sesamum seed, wetted or damped
ingredients.sourceText: til or sesamum seed, wetted or damped

steps: Place on a large tray a layer of the flowers, about four inches thick and two feet square
Put some of the til or sesamum seed, wetted or damped, about two inches thick on this
Place another layer of flowers, four inches thick on top
Cover the whole with a sheet, held down by weights at the sides
Allow to remain for eighteen hours
Remove the flowers and replace by layers of fresh flowers
Repeat the operation three times, each layer of fresh flowers being allowed to remain eighteen hours
After the last process, take the seeds in their swollen state and place them in a clean mill
Express the oil, which will possess the scent of the flowers
Keep in prepared skins, called dubbers

title: Indian Way of Making Calf's-Foot Jelly
description: Prepared with limes, oranges, and lemon.

ingredients.name: one pound or half a seer of sugar
ingredients.sourceText: one pound or half a seer of sugar

ingredients.name: half a dozen blades of lemon-grass
ingredients.sourceText: half a dozen blades of lemon-grass

steps: Thoroughly wash the feet, break them up and boil them
Allow all the meat to dissolve over a slow fire
Skim away every particle of fat
Strain the liquid through a coarse napkin
Add the sugar, all the hot spices, and the rinds of two lemons and one orange
Simmer the whole for some time
Squeeze in the juice of the eight limes and the two oranges, together with the isinglass and lemon-grass
When it begins to thicken strain it
Reboil until it is reduced to the required quantity, skimming all the fat
Beat the whites of the six eggs to a good light froth
Add this to the jelly, and pour it from one pan into another several times, until it clears
Add the sherry and strain it through flannel, returning it quickly two or three times until it runs perfectly bright and clear
Fill into glasses or moulds before it congeals

steps: Boil down eight calves'-feet, with some pepper and salt, two onions, a head of celery, and two carrots, in three or four quarts of water

Pour what you require over the ready cooked or dressed meat into moulds
Let the rest cool in some large flat dish, and cut it up small for garnishing the meat or bird when served up

title: Jelly with Fruit
description: Prepared with gelatine, whites of eggs, and juice.

ingredients.name: three quarters of a pound of sugar
ingredients.sourceText: three quarters of a pound of sugar

steps: Put {{source-0}} in an enamelled stew-pan with three quarters of a pound of sugar.
Beat three whites of eggs, moisten them with one quart of water and the juice of one lime.
Pour the whole into the stew-pan containing the gelatine.
Put it on the fire, whisking the liquid continually until it boils.
Take the pan from the fire, let the liquid cool, and strain it through a jelly bag, pouring it back and straining again until it is quite clear.
When cold, flavour the jelly with maraschino, a wine-glass will be sufficient.
Let it rest awhile.
Prepare a macedoine of fruits: preserved cherries, strawberries, apricots, greengages, and raspberries.
Fill the jelly mould as follows: first set it upon ice, and pour into it about one-eighth thickness of the jelly.
Arrange some fruit tastefully in this layer, cover it with jelly.
Continue layers of fruit and of jelly until the mould is nearly full.
Finish it with jelly only.
Cover the mould with ice, and turn it out when finally set and quite firm.
Iced cream en bloc may accompany.

title: Jilapi
description: Prepared with ghee, sugar syrup, and water.
steps: Mix 1 powa of water with 1 powa of middlings
Keep aside for 5 or 6 hours
Then mix with 1 seer of sabeda, a pinch of saffron and an adequate quantity of water making a thick paste
Boil 0.5 seer or 3 powas of ghee in a pan till vapour rises
Put the paste in a coconut shell or a linen bag with a small hole at the bottom
Drop it in the pan in a thin stream
Make suitable designs by manipulating the hand, the common one being a spiral of two circumferences crossed by one straight line
Fry both sides till hard and red
Take them out and keep immersed in a syrup of sugar till saturated

title: Jugged Hare
description: Prepared with hare, stock, and carrots.

ingredients.name: pint and a half of good strong stock
ingredients.sourceText: pint and a half of good strong stock

ingredients.name: a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly
ingredients.sourceText: a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly

ingredients.name: a lump of butter rolled in flour
ingredients.sourceText: a lump of butter rolled in flour

steps: Skin and clean the hare
Cut the hare up into neat pieces
Dredge them with flour
Give them a few turns in the frying-pan with some butter till they take colour
Prepare beforehand a pint and a half of good strong stock
Choose a vessel that you can close securely with paste
Put the pieces of hare into it, with two carrots, two or three large onions, an ounce of celery, the juice of two limes, a table-spoonful of sugar, and one of salt
Pour in the stock
Throw in a wine-glass of brandy
Seal the vessel as closely as possible
Place it in a pan of cold water
Set it to boil, steaming the covered pot for three hours
When done, open the pot
Stir into it a bumper glass of port, a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly, and a lump of butter rolled in flour
Serve with a dozen balls of stuffing made as for roast hare, and fried in butter
Alternatively, the jar may be placed in the oven and baked for two or three hours

title: Kachuri
description: Small fried dough discs filled with spiced minced meat cooked in ghee. Cooked peas or cauliflower may be mixed into the meat filling as optional additions.
steps: Mix salt, a pinch of sodium bicarbonate, powders of fried pepper, cumin, garam-masala and coriander with minced meat and fry with ghee, adding a little water if necessary to boil the meat.

Press them into small, round, flat discs of moderate thickness and fry in plenty of ghee.
Boiled and pasted green peas and cauliflowers may be mixed with the meat.

title: Kasundi
description: Prepared with mangoes, mango, and chillies.
steps: Peel some mature yet green mangoes and cut them in thin long pieces throwing away the seeds if possible
Mix 1 powa of salt with 1 seer of such pieces and keep in the sun for a day or two till the pieces are quite soft and some juice is gathered at the bottom
Drain out the juice and mix the pieces with pasted ginger 1 chhatak, powdered chillies 1½ chhataks, powdered mustard 3 chhataks, seedless ripe tamarind 1 chhatak and salt 1 chhatak
Heat 1 powa of mustard oil in an aluminium pan, add the spiced pieces, mix thoroughly and take down
Preserve them when cold in an airtight stone, porcelain, glass or earthen jar

Prepare threads of it as fine as possible rolling it little by little with the hands, adding a little water if necessary

Add raisins, pasted almonds and 1½ powa of sugar
Stir at intervals and take down when thick after mixing with cardamom seeds and 3 or 4 drops of essence of rose

title: Kheer of Tal
description: Prepared with fruit, raisins, and almonds.
steps: Skin a sweet and ripe tal fruit and separate the seeds.
Beat each a little with the hands and rub against a sieve or a small basket of bamboo or iron placing a plate beneath it.
The pulp of the fruit will be collected on the plate.
The pulp may be used now as it is but it tastes better if it is mixed with a little water and held high in a bag of linen till the whole of the water is drained off in drops.
Heat 1 seer of milk on very mild heat till it is reduced to 3 powas when add 1/2 seer of the pulp and stir constantly.
Take down when the mass is thick and gluey after mixing with raisins, pieces of almonds and pistachios, powders of cardamoms and aniseeds 1/2 tola each and very little camphor.
Serve when cool with bread.

title: Kidney Soup
description: A soup made with mutton, anchovy, and consomme.

ingredients.name: a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly
ingredients.sourceText: a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly

steps: Wash the kidneys, dry them, slit them in halves, and plunge them immediately into boiling water well salted
Let them remain in this bath for one minute only, take them out, and dry them in a napkin
Having thus blanched the kidneys, proceed to boil them gently with some dried thyme, marjoram, and a bag containing spice, &c., till they are very tender
Take them out, and pound them in the mortar, with one well washed anchovy
When sufficiently pounded, pass the paste through a wire sieve to get rid of fibre, gristle, &c.
Place the consomme in a bowl handy, and keep the kidney paste ready in a soup plate
Take a roomy sauce-pan, melt an ounce of butter at the bottom of it over the fire, stir in a table-spoonful of flour

title: Kidney Stew
description: Prepared with mutton, juice, and garlic.

ingredients.name: three dessertspoonfuls of ghee or lard
ingredients.sourceText: three dessertspoonfuls of ghee or lard

steps: Steep in lukewarm water for a few minutes a dozen mutton kidneys, and remove the white skin or coat which will become perceptible
Cut into halves or quarter them, wash in three or four waters, and allow them to remain as long as possible in pepper, salt, and the juice of onions, ginger, and garlic

Boil up three dessertspoonfuls of ghee or lard in a deep frying-pan, throw in the kidneys with the juice, put in half a clove of garlic, and cover over the whole with eight large Patna onions sliced each into eight slices, and separated so as to cover over the whole surface of the pan
Pour over it as much hot stock as will keep all the onions under, and simmer over a slow fire until the onions disappear
Serve up quite hot

title: Kidney Toast
description: Prepared with kidney, toast, and kidneys.

ingredients.name: a few drops of chilli vinegar

ingredients.name: four squares of hot fried toast

steps: Blanch the kidneys in scalding water
Lift them out and dry them in a cloth
Make a strong broth or gravy out of any bones or scraps
Stew the kidneys in the gravy till they are nice and tender
Take them out, drain them, and pour the gravy into a bowl
Cut up and pound the kidneys to a paste in a mortar with some butter and pass it through a sieve
Skim any grease from the top of the gravy
Melt a dessert-spoonful of butter at the bottom of a sauce-pan
Stir into it a dessert-spoonful of flour
When creamy, add by degrees a breakfast-cupful of the gravy
Add kidney-paste until all is expended
Flavour the puree with one table-spoonful port wine, one tea-spoonful red currant jelly, one dessert-spoonful anchovy vinegar, and a few drops of chilli vinegar
Let the contents of the sauce-pan thicken properly by coming to the boil
Pour the puree over four squares of hot fried toast
Serve without delay

title: Leg of Mutton Dumpling
description: Prepared with leg of mutton, suet, and flour.

ingredients.name: one seer and a quarter of soojee
ingredients.sourceText: one seer and a quarter of soojee

steps: Prepare a good pie-crust with one seer and a quarter of soojee, half a seer of flour, and half a seer of suet, as per recipe No. 199.
Clean and trim the leg, cutting away the end of the knuckle-bone, and any other projections likely to injure the dumpling.
Sprinkle it well with ground pepper and some salt, and confine it securely in the pastry, closing all joinings with the aid of a little water.
Place the dumpling into a strong napkin, previously buttered and dredged with flour.
Tie it securely, and allow it to boil from three to four hours.
Care must be taken that during the whole process of boiling the dumpling remains suspended in the water, and not resting on the bottom of the pan.

On removing it from the boiler, plunge it immediately into a large tureen of cold water for two or three minutes. This will strengthen the pastry and prevent its bursting or breaking while it is being served up.

title: Lime Fritters
description: Prepared with limes, lemon, and fat.

ingredients.name: finely sifted sugar
ingredients.sourceText: one ounce of finely sifted sugar

ingredients.name: rasped peel of three nice limes
ingredients.sourceText: rasped peel of three nice limes

ingredients.name: a few drops of lemon essence

ingredients.name: a glass of brandy or Madeira

steps: Mix together in a sauce-pan {{source-0}} and an ounce of fresh butter
Add a coffee-cup of milk and stir to the consistency of a thick batter; if too thick dilute with a little more milk
Stir in {{source-3}} and the rasped peel of three nice limes with a few drops of lemon essence
Stir the whole mixture over the fire till thoroughly heated, but on no account let it boil
When well mixed and hot, place the batter on one side to get cool
Break four eggs into a bowl separating the yolks from the whites
Beat the former and whisk the latter to a froth
Add the yolks to the cool batter and stir thoroughly
At the last add the whisked whites
Prepare a deep bath of boiling fat and set your frying basket therein
Drop the batter into it by dessert-spoonfuls at a time
Each spoonful will form itself into a ball and turn gradually a golden yellow
When they are all done, drain and serve them in a napkin, dusted over with well powdered sugar
For the sauce: Make a nice syrup with white sugar and water, stir in a glass of brandy or Madeira, give it the juice of a lime, and serve hot

ingredients.sourceText: a tea-spoonful of powdered dried sweet herbs

steps: Trim the loin nicely, and let it lie from morning till roasting time in marinade, composed of a breakfast-cupful of salad oil, two onions, and a carrot, sliced fine as for Julienne, with some whole peppers, salt, chopped parsley, and a tea-spoonful of powdered dried sweet herbs.

When nearly done, remove the paper, brush off the vegetables, baste with melted butter, and serve, when nicely browned, with other vegetables independently cooked, and some gravy.

title: Macaroni
description: Prepared with eggs and flour.
steps: Take the yolks and white of two fresh eggs, and as much finely-sifted flour as will make a good dough of the consistency of dough for pie-crusts without the addition of any water
Roll it out to its full extent on a large board to about the thickness of an eight-anna piece
Cut it up into small squares, diamonds, or circles, or into any shape or design you please
Do this quickly, as within an hour of its being rolled out the pastry will harden
It may be used immediately, or in the winter it may be kept good for a few days

title: Macaroni Pie
description: A pastry dish made with macaroni, beef, and white pepper.

ingredients.name: a dessertspoonful of very dry mustard
ingredients.sourceText: a dessertspoonful of very dry mustard

ingredients.name: half a teaspoonful of very finely powdered white pepper
ingredients.sourceText: half a teaspoonful of very finely powdered white pepper

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of butter
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of butter

steps: Take half a pound of macaroni, boil and throw away the first water.
Then boil it again in some milk, and remove when it is quite tender.
Prepare a strong gravy or soup with {{source-2}}, well seasoned with ground white pepper, salt, and soup herbs.
Bruise into fine powder two ounces of some good English cheese.
Pound very fine a couple of crisp biscuits.
Pour over the boiled macaroni sufficient beef gravy or stock to entirely cover it.
Put in all the pepper, salt, and mustard, but only half the ground cheese.
Set it to simmer over a slow fire until the gravy begins to dry, and the macaroni acquires some consistency.
With three ounces of butter butter well the baking-dish.
Pour into it the macaroni.
Mix the remaining ground cheese with the powdered biscuit, and strew it over the pie.
Cut into small pieces the remaining ounce of butter, and throw that also over the pie.
Put the dish into an oven, and bake to a fine light but rich brown colour for ten to fifteen minutes.

title: Maccaroni in the Italian Fashion
description: Prepared with garlic, tomato, and parmesan cheese or cheese.

ingredients.name: grated Parmesan cheese or mild powdered dry cheese
ingredients.sourceText: grated Parmesan cheese or mild powdered dry cheese

steps: Boil the maccaroni in boiling water in a sauce-pan (which may be rubbed with a clove of garlic) until it is tender
The moment it is tender, stop the boiling by adding a cup of cold water
Drain it carefully, as you do rice, and let it remain in the hot sauce-pan
Stir into it a table-spoonful of the best fresh, or preserved butter
Work this about over the fire whilst an assistant adds by degrees a breakfast-cupful of fresh tomato pulp, a little salt and black pepper
Add lastly, a heaped up table-spoonful of either grated Parmesan from the bottle, or any mild thoroughly powdered dry cheese
Serve steaming hot without delay. The cheese should form long threads when lifted from the dish with the maccaroni

title: Madhuramla Khanda
description: Prepared with curd, ghee, and water.
steps: Mix 1/2 powa of curd with 1/2 seer of besam of moog and add water making a thin paste.
Beat the paste for about 15 minutes.
Boil it and stir continuously till the paste is very thick.
Place the paste on a wooden plate and stir till stirring is quite difficult.
Press the paste flat about 1/2 inch thick.
Cut it in cubes with a knife when cold.
Fry the cubes with sufficient ghee and immerse in a syrup of sugar.
Mix 1/4 tola of powdered garam-masala, 1/4 tola of powdered pepper and a little salt with about 1.5 powa of curd and heat.
Drop the cubes in the curd when it is warm, continue heating and take down when the curd is thick and sticks to the sides of the cubes.

title: Maintenon Cutlets
description: Prepared with mutton, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: eight nicely trimmed choplets of mutton
ingredients.sourceText: eight nicely trimmed choplets of mutton

steps: Put eight nicely trimmed choplets of mutton into a stew-pan with some scraps of bacon, onion, carrot, spices, pepper, salt, and a pinch of grated nutmeg
Add a pint of good gravy, and a glass of sherry
Gently stew the little chops till done
Lay them out on a large dish, covered by another with a weight upon it
When quite cold, trim them finally into shape if necessary
Strain the gravy in which they were stewed
Remove all fat
Mince an onion very small, and a few capers, with two or three truffles also
Fry the onions a golden brown
Add the minced capers and truffles with pepper, salt, and a spoonful of chopped parsley
Moisten with a little of the gravy
Thicken it with a couple of eggs
Put the mince away to get cold
Cut some papers for your cutlets and oil or butter them
Spread your cold thick mince over your cutlets liberally
Fold them in their papers most carefully
Broil them on the grid-iron sufficiently long to heat them thoroughly, or heat them in the oven
Serve your cutlets in their papers

Hand round a rich sauce made of the remains of the gravy originally got from the cooking of the cutlets, slightly thickened with butter and flour, flavoured with red currant jelly, anchovy vinegar, and a spoonful of sherry
Place the cutlets round a ring of mashed potatoes filled with celery puree

Fry the onions a golden brown
Add the minced capers and truffles with pepper, salt, and a spoonful of chopped parsley
Moisten with a little of the gravy
Thicken it with a couple of eggs
Put the mince away to get cold
Cut some papers for your cutlets and oil or butter them
Spread your cold thick mince over your cutlets liberally
Fold them in their papers most carefully
Broil them on the grid-iron sufficiently long to heat them thoroughly, or heat them in the oven
Serve your cutlets in their papers

Hand round a rich sauce made of the remains of the gravy originally got from the cooking of the cutlets, slightly thickened with butter and flour, flavoured with red currant jelly, anchovy vinegar, and a spoonful of sherry
Place the cutlets round a ring of mashed potatoes filled with celery puree

title: Mayonnaise Sauce
description: A sauce made with mustard, shallot, and white pepper.
steps: Put into a soup-plate or slop-basin the cold, very hard-boiled yolks of two eggs, a salt-spoonful of salt, a dessert-spoonful of mustard powder, a tea-spoonful of finely-minced shallot, and a dust of white pepper
Bruise these together thoroughly with the back of a silver spoon
Add a little oil, and work your materials to a paste, dropping in the oil patiently by degrees until you get it nice and moist
Throw in the yolks of two raw eggs, and continue your working
Add oil without measure, judging by your eye when you think you have made enough sauce
Finally add tarragon vinegar, not more than a good table-spoonful
When the vinegar is added, the sauce will assume a creamy appearance
When worked sufficiently, pass through a block tin strainer to get rid of onion atoms and lumps of egg
Ice the sauce, if only for a few minutes, before serving

title: Mayonnaise Sauce
description: A sauce made with juice, salad oil, and lettuce.

ingredients.name: yolks of three large, or four ordinary Indian eggs
ingredients.sourceText: yolks of three large, or four ordinary Indian eggs

ingredients.name: balls of green or yellow butter
ingredients.sourceText: balls of green or yellow butter

steps: Put the yolks of three large, or four ordinary Indian eggs (raw) in a flat joint dish with a tea-spoonful of salt, and the juice of two limes, and beat them well
Tip the dish on end at an angle of about 35 degrees, by slipping a thick book under the rim at one end

Open a fresh bottle of salad oil, and get an assistant to let the oil fall, in rapidly succeeding drops, upon the centre of the dish, whilst you continue beating the egg mixture upwards to make it pass under the stream of dripping oil
Half a pint of salad oil may be thus expended, until you have a sauce as thick as treacle, and of a golden yellow tint
Arrange your mayonnaise in its dish
Shake a few drops of tarragon vinegar over it, with a dust of black pepper
Arrange some well dried lettuce leaves, trimmed with a silver dessert knife, over the mayonnaise
Garnish as you like, with broken aspic jelly, gherkins, turned olives, capers, fillets of anchovy, balls of green or yellow butter, plain hard-boiled yolks of egg whole
Ice the sauce, and pour it over all

title: Meat Bread
description: A bread preparation made with rabbit or hare, lemon-juice, and salt.
steps: Prepare a rabbit or hare, cut in big pieces and keep them immersed in saline water for half an hour.
Boil the pieces of salted meat in fresh water.
Take out the boiled pieces and remove the bones.
Mix them with 2 or 3 eggs, sugar, powdered pepper, ginger-juice, a few drops of lemon-juice, a small quantity of flour, salt and a little water in which meat had been boiled, if necessary.
Form rectangular cakes of moderate thickness, cover with white paper and fry with butter on mild heat for about half an hour.

title: Meringues
description: Prepared with eggs and sugar.
steps: Put the whites of seven eggs into a bowl, and whip them as stiffly as possible
Add half a pound of sugar, mix well
With a spoon set portions of the mixture at intervals on sheets of buttered paper
Each piece should be the size and shape of an egg
Dredge some pounded sugar over them, and put them in the oven upon a baking-sheet
As soon as they assume a pale yellow tint, remove them from the oven, detach them from the paper, and cut them in halves with a very sharp knife
Scoop out the inside with a spoon as carefully as you can, and return them to a moderate oven to dry
Fill the pieces with any nicely flavoured whipped cream, join the halves together with white of egg cement, and serve piled up upon a napkin

steps: Clean, pick, and roast the dal
Mix it up with all the ground condiments and salt
Put into a pot and pour water over the whole, some two inches above the dal
Boil it well until the dal has quite dissolved, allowing it to cake as it were en masse
Churn the dal by twirling it in a wooden instrument called a phootnee
Warm the ghee in a separate pot and fry the onions
Chop the onions and throw into the churned dal
Pour the dal into the pot of melted ghee and keep stirring until the dal and ghee have well mixed
Put the cover on and allow to simmer over a slow fire for about a quarter of an hour
