ingredients.sourceText: 1 tola of dried and powdered ginger

steps: Keep 2 seers of dried paddy out on a cold moist floor for 2 to 3 hours
Heat a quantity of sands in a pan till they are very hot
Throw a handful of the paddy on the hot sands and stir them
The paddy will burst into khai in half a minute
Remove them immediately to avoid burning
Fry the whole quantity of paddy in this way
Remove the chaffs
Boil a syrup of 1 seer of sugar
Add 1 seer of fresh khai and stir constantly

When the khai are powdered and mixed up with the syrup add seeds of small cardamoms 1/2 tola, powdered cinnamon 1/2 tola, powdered pepper 1 tola and dried and powdered ginger 1 tola and very little camphor
Add pasted almonds and pistachios as desired
Stir till the mass is gluey
Taking down mix with 1/2 powa of pure cows' ghee
Make balls when it is yet warm
Roll the ball on powdered sugar and serve when cold

title: Mulligatawny Soup
description: A soup made with beef, chicken, and ghee.

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee

ingredients.name: half a teaspoonful of ground ginger
ingredients.sourceText: half a teaspoonful of ground ginger

ingredients.name: a quarter of a teaspoonful of ground garlic
ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of a teaspoonful of ground garlic

ingredients.name: half a teaspoonful of roasted and ground coriander-seed
ingredients.sourceText: half a teaspoonful of roasted and ground coriander-seed

ingredients.name: a quarter of a teaspoonful of roasted and ground cumin-seed
ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of a teaspoonful of roasted and ground cumin-seed

ingredients.name: one chittack or two ounces of roasted and ground poppy-seeds
ingredients.sourceText: one chittack or two ounces of roasted and ground poppy-seeds

ingredients.name: half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves
ingredients.sourceText: half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves

steps: Prepare a shin of beef soup as above, omitting the sauce, wine, and white of egg
Set the soup aside
Take a full-sized curry chicken; cut it up into sixteen or eighteen pieces, and wash them thoroughly
Warm a pot and melt in it two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
Fry in it some finely-sliced onions, and set aside

Then fry in the melted ghee the following condiments: four teaspoonfuls of ground onions, one teaspoonful of ground turmeric, one teaspoonful of ground chilies, half a teaspoonful of ground ginger, a quarter of a teaspoonful of ground garlic, half a teaspoonful of roasted and ground coriander-seed, and a quarter of a teaspoonful of roasted and ground cumin-seed
Sprinkle a little water over these while frying
Then add the cut up chicken with two teaspoonfuls of salt
When nearly brown, add one chittack or two ounces of roasted and ground poppy-seeds
Pour in the beef soup, add the fried onion and half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves
Close the pot, and allow the whole to simmer over a slow fire until the chicken be perfectly tender
Serve up hot, with limes cut in slices on a separate plate

title: Mulligatawny Soup Another Way
description: A soup made with beef, chicken, and ghee.

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of ghee

ingredients.name: two chittacks or four ounces of roasted and ground chunna ka or gram dal
ingredients.sourceText: two chittacks or four ounces of roasted and ground chunna ka or gram dal

ingredients.name: half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves
ingredients.sourceText: half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves

steps: Prepare a shin of beef as directed above
Cut up a chicken; wash it and set it aside
Heat a pot and melt in it two chittacks or four ounces of ghee
After frying in it and setting aside some finely-sliced onions, fry the condiments in the proportions given in the foregoing recipe
Then add the cut-up chicken with two teaspoonfuls of salt
Brown it nicely
Have ready two chittacks or four ounces of roasted and ground chunna ka or gram dal, which mix thoroughly in a cup of strong coconut milk, and pour over the chicken just as it has become brown
Stir it well, and add the fried onions and the soup, with half a dozen of the kurreeah fool leaves
Close the pot, and allow the whole to simmer for three-quarters of an hour
Serve up hot, with limes, either whole or cut in slices, on a separate plate

title: Mulligatunny
description: Prepared with chicken or fowl, onions, and almonds.

ingredients.name: a well-nurtured chicken or young fowl
ingredients.sourceText: a well-nurtured chicken or young fowl

ingredients.name: a couple of table-spoonfuls of mulligatunny paste or curry-powder
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of table-spoonfuls of mulligatunny paste or curry-powder

ingredients.name: a couple of pints of warm water
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of pints of warm water

ingredients.name: a couple of ounces of almonds
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of ounces of almonds

ingredients.name: a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly
ingredients.sourceText: a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly

steps: Cut up a well-nurtured chicken or young fowl as if for fricassee, soak the pieces in cold water for a quarter of an hour
Slice up a couple of good-sized onions, and put them, with two table-spoonfuls of butter, into a stew-pan on a good fire
Fry the chicken and onions together till slightly browned
Pick out the chicken, and stir into the butter a couple of table-spoonfuls of mulligatunny paste or curry-powder
Cook the paste or powder with the butter and onions for five minutes
Stir in a couple of pints of warm water
Add the chicken; and if the pieces are not quite covered, put in water enough to do so
Let the contents come to the boil, then ease off the fire, and simmer for half an hour very gently
Pound a couple of ounces of almonds in a mortar, with a coffee-cupful of milk, give it a pinch of sugar, and let the mixture stand till wanted
Ascertain that the chicken is quite tender, then stir in a dessert-spoonful of good chutney, a tea-spoonful of red currant jelly, and a tea-spoonful of lime-juice
After five minutes' simmering, strain off the whole of the liquid into a bowl
Pick out the nicest pieces of chicken for garnish, and put them aside
Skim the surface of the liquid, and when quite clear of grease, proceed to thicken it, using a table-spoonful of butter and one of flour, and stirring in the soup slowly
Strain into the sauce-pan the almond milk, using a piece of muslin in order to catch up the bits of nut
Let the mulligatunny come to the boil, and serve

title: Mulligatunny
description: Prepared with onion, veal stock, and currant jelly.

ingredients.name: three table-spoonfuls Barrie's Madras mulligatunny paste
ingredients.sourceText: three table-spoonfuls Barrie's Madras mulligatunny paste

steps: Cut up a large sweet onion into fine rings, and fry them in two ounces of good butter, till about to turn yellow
Stir in three table-spoonfuls of Barrie's Madras mulligatunny paste, adding sufficient stock to bring the mixture to the consistency of mayonnaise sauce
Taste the mixture, and if it requires a little sub-acid, administer a table-spoonful of red currant jelly and a few drops of lemon juice
Stir in well a dessert-spoonful of Madras chutney, and add stock enough to produce a thin soup—about three pints in all
Allow to simmer for a quarter of an hour to extract the flavours of the various ingredients
Pound four ounces of sweet almonds in a mortar with a little milk, using a breakfast-cupful altogether
Strain the almond milk into the soup, and stop the simmering
Pass the whole of the liquid through a tin strainer into a clean bowl to catch up lumps of onion, chutney, &c.
Skim the mulligatunny
Thicken with two ounces of butter and two of flour
Bring the soup to boiling-point
Just before serving, off the fire, stir a coffee-cupful of the best cream into the tureen as the soup is poured into it
